newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco unleaded seen firming on tight stocks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco unleaded seen firming on tight stocks.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline basis was seen firming next week on tight stocks ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend, traders said on Friday.

Basis has remained strong over the past week despite higher output in the Midwest, where refineries in the region were operating above 98 percent of capacity in the latest American Petroleum Institute survey.
Most Chicago traders wound down trade in late-November deliveries this week and were shifting focus to early December barrels.
"It's going to be dead," one trader said of discussion next week ahead of the long holiday weekend.

The Williams pipeline system, a key barometer of stocks in the Group Three market, reported a relatively thin 18-day supply of gasoline and a relatively large 32-day supply of low sulphur diesel stocks on hand.
Conoco, Coastal and Texaco were sighted in the market for late-November barrels on Friday, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was steady at bids 5.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded for prompt deliveries and 3.50 cents over the print for later deliveries.
Chicago unleaded was talked 3.50/3.75 cents a gallon over the print for late-November deliveries, with first-cycle December barrels 4.50/4.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX January unleaded futures.

Group Three low sulphur diesel differentials eased late Friday to 1.50/1.25 cent a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 2.0/1.75 cent under for later deliveries. High sulphur eased to 2.50 cent a gallon under the print.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was bid 1.0 cent a gallon over NYMEX December heating oil for late-November deliveries, and high sulphur was bid 0.50 cent over the print.
